news.title: The Chopras founder questions the “agent bazaar” as he unveils EduNavigatorX.ai
news.summary_en: At The PIE Live Germany, Naveen Chopra warned that commissions can influence where students are advised to apply and questioned how much universities know about the agents and sub-agents guiding those decisions.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: 200k UK-EU youth mobility places agreed as tuition fee decision delayed
news.summary_en: The UK and EU have agreed a landmark youth mobility scheme allowing 100,000 young people from each side to live, work and study across borders for up to three years, but a contentious decision on university tuition fees has been pushed back by six months.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: “A one-year decline is not a one-year problem”: America’s shrinking talent pipeline
news.summary_en: Further drops in America’s international student population are set to cost the US economy $2.4bn in lost revenue this year, with analysts warning of the long-term consequences of a shrinking pipeline of international talent.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Former BMI founders launch new international education events company
news.summary_en: Former BMI founders Samir Zaveri and Rupert Merrick have launched a new international education events company, Campus Global, following the closure of BMI earlier this year.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Home Office has “hung together” all UK unis, think tank warns
news.summary_en: UK universities have allowed themselves to be "hung together" by the Home Office as a result of the sector's collective approach to international recruitment, the director of a conservative think tank has said.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: “A major relief”: US stakeholders react to Duration of Status reprieve
news.summary_en: The US international education sector has breathed a sigh of relief after a federal judge blocked the Trump administration's attempt to scrap the Duration of Status rule.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Manifest Global acquires Mindler’s career guidance business
news.summary_en: The Singapore-based group plans to extend the Indian company’s career assessment from Cialfo schools in India to users of BridgeU and FlowAI, and expand certification for counsellors in India and abroad.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Record £400m Erasmus+ funding opens international opportunities for UK
news.summary_en: More than 100,000 people across the UK are expected to benefit from international education, training and development opportunities as applications open for a record £400 million in Erasmus+ funding.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Shoolini and Edinburgh partner on engineering degrees across India and the UK
news.summary_en: Students will study engineering in India and Scotland, with Shoolini planning to subsidise the program and build closer teaching and research links with Edinburgh.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Independent HE grows as minister signals “enormous opportunities”
news.summary_en: The UK's skills minister has signalled "enormous opportunities" for independent higher education providers as new figures show the sector now teaches almost one in 17 UK HE students.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: UKVI rejects 80% of students called to interview as visa refusals surge
news.summary_en: The UKVI rejected 79% of prospective students called to a credibility interview in a six-month period, new data seen by The PIE has revealed.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: “Students are talking”: NUS president warns moving goalposts are costing Brand UK
news.summary_en: International students are sharing their experiences of refusals and changing rules, and the UK's reputation is paying the price, warns Favour Samuel, the first international student to lead the National Union of Students (NUS) England.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Irish universities face €8m fee shortfall after student visa refusals
news.summary_en: Ireland’s Labour Party wants a review of student visa refusals as one university warns of cuts to master’s courses and the Department of Justice says its application criteria are unchanged.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Hong Kong takes three of Asia’s top five places in QS university rankings
news.summary_en: Singapore’s two leading universities slipped out of Asia’s top five, 16 Malaysian institutions reached their highest ranks yet and India’s representation in the top 200 rose from 20 universities to 21.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Going Global Istanbul to spotlight HE resilience and global partnerships
news.summary_en: Education leaders from around the world are coming together for three days in Istanbul to discuss the future of higher and further education in Türkiye, Central Asia, and the South Caucasus.
news.author: Jenna O'Flynn
